args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0 — the service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failed deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommendation: keep v2.3.1 quarantined until the root cause of the health-check failures is identified and fixed.
